stories.title: OpenAI launches Dots, its Muse competitor
stories.summary: OpenAI announced 'dots', its new always-on personal AI agent designed to compete directly with Meta's Muse, following safety-related delays on core models.
stories.why: Highlights the escalating commercial battle between Big Tech giants in consumer AI agents.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO docs reportedly reveal over $40 billion in losses last year
stories.summary: Anthropic's newly revealed IPO documentation indicates massive scaling costs with over $40 billion in losses, highlighting heavy infrastructure commitments.
stories.why: Provides critical financial visibility into the unit economics of frontier AI model builders ahead of public listings.

related.title: Anthropic's IPO prospectus shows sweeping AI vision, surging costs

stories.title: OpenAI targets $30 billion in new funding at $1.4 trillion value
stories.summary: OpenAI is reportedly in talks to raise a $30 billion funding round at a staggering $1.4 trillion valuation ahead of its planned 2027 public debut.
stories.why: Sets a new benchmark for private market capital requirements and valuations in the generative AI sector.

stories.title: 'Almost like a constitution': Trump & tech giants sign ‘morally binding' AI pact on safety measures
stories.summary: US President Trump and major tech executives signed a voluntary, 'morally binding' agreement backing self-regulation and data center expansion over strict government rules.
stories.why: Signals a pro-growth regulatory environment for enterprise AI strategy and infrastructure investments in the US.

stories.title: a16z-backed EliseAI raises $350M, doubles valuation to $4B
stories.summary: Vertical AI automation platform EliseAI raised $350 million in a round led by Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer, doubling its valuation to $4 billion.
stories.why: Demonstrates strong investor appetite for verticalized enterprise software applications over generic chat tools.

stories.title: Arivihan Nets $10.2 Mn To Scale Its AI Tutoring Platform
stories.summary: AI-driven edtech startup Arivihan secured $10.2 million in its Series A funding round to scale its automated tutoring platform.
stories.why: Showcases ongoing venture capital interest in specialized AI education applications within emerging markets.

stories.title: AI agents are fighting over your shopping cart: Meta’s Muse blocked by Amazon and Walmart
stories.summary: E-commerce majors Amazon and Walmart have blocked Meta’s Muse AI shopping agent from accessing their platforms over cart and data security concerns.
stories.why: Exposes platform friction and friction points as agentic AI begins transacting directly on behalf of users.

related.title: Shopify opens checkout to browser-based AI agents

stories.title: India's tech sector faces 53-60% talent gap in GenAI, cloud: Report
stories.summary: A new TeamLease report reveals that India's tech sector is facing a severe 53% to 60% talent gap in generative AI and cloud skills.
stories.why: Highlights a major structural bottleneck for Indian enterprises and IT services scaling up AI capabilities.

stories.title: US-based Reco raises $55 million to monitor AI agents, with strategic investment from AT&T
stories.summary: Security startup Reco raised $55 million with backing from AT&T to monitor and protect enterprise AI agents against autonomous risks.
stories.why: Illustrates the rise of a new cybersecurity sub-sector addressing agentic vulnerabilities and shadow AI.

stories.title: The real prize in AMD’s $8 billion World Labs acquisition isn’t what you’d think
stories.summary: AMD's $8 billion acquisition of World Labs positions the chipmaker more aggressively against Nvidia in physical and spatial AI hardware.
stories.why: Reflects hardware giants consolidating advanced AI software and spatial intelligence capabilities.

related.title: AMD is acquiring AI company World Labs in a deal worth more than $8 billion

stories.title: IIM Kozhikode partners with Walmart Global Tech to nurture Indian deeptech startups
stories.summary: IIM Kozhikode's incubator partnered with Walmart Global Tech to launch DEEP LEAP, backing 50 early-stage deeptech startups.
stories.why: Strengthens the institutional and corporate venture framework for Indian deeptech and AI entrepreneurship.

stories.title: AI chip startup SiMa.ai raises $150M at $1.45B valuation
stories.summary: Edge AI chip startup SiMa.ai raised $150 million at a $1.45 billion valuation to accelerate its physical AI hardware deployments.
stories.why: Proves continued investor demand for specialized edge processing chips optimized for physical and industrial AI.

related.title: SiMa.ai Raises $150 Million Series C At $1.45 Billion Valuation To Scale Physical AI Platform

stories.title: Visa joins growing alarm over AI-powered risks
stories.summary: Visa has open-sourced part of its AI-powered cybersecurity defense infrastructure after vulnerabilities were exposed during recent AI testing.
stories.why: Demonstrates how legacy financial institutions are hardening payment networks against escalating AI-driven cyber threats.

stories.title: Meta’s Muse AI sent a YouTuber’s address to a stranger
stories.summary: Reports surfaced that Meta's Muse AI agent mistakenly shared a user's home address and arranged pickups, sparking fresh privacy scrutiny.
stories.why: Emphasizes the operational and reputational product risks associated with autonomous consumer-facing agent deployments.

stories.title: General Intuition raises $220M at $6.2B valuation to train AI on gameplay
stories.summary: General Intuition raised $220 million at a $6.2 billion valuation to train advanced AI models on gameplay data.
stories.why: Underscores massive capital inflows into alternative synthetic training environments for next-generation intelligence.
